_reader: Claude (Opus 5.5), the architecture role that wrote the pipeline and the checks; after unblinding, 13 Nov 2026. Not an independent or human reader.
_method: For each effective fault the reader compared the generator's sealed intended effect (manifest.json) with the clean and patched records, replay outputs and reload comparison of the episodes the manifest names (results/ft_perrun_r2/<fault>.json, from tools/ft_perrun.py), and with which checks newly fired on which run. 'matches' means every value or outcome the manifest states was observed. Localization codes: cause = a firing check tests the mechanism the patch broke; other_run = a check fired on a different run through a side effect of the mechanism, not on the run the manifest names; diffuse = several checks across several layers fire, among them the one testing the mechanism; downstream = the fault surfaces as an exception in a later layer; missed = no check of the full configuration fired.
